Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: Crude Oil all time high by...?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (8% odds) on crude reaching a new all-time high. Closes in ~1mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.
